caption: 3 ways to use up zucchini 🥒 save this before summer ends

transcript.text: Okay so I have way too much zucchini and here are three ways to use it.
First up, zucchini fritters. Grate two medium zucchini and squeeze out all the water.
Mix with one egg, a quarter cup flour, salt, pepper, and half a cup of feta.
Pan fry in olive oil about 3 minutes per side until golden.
Second recipe is zucchini pasta. Use a spiralizer to make noodles from two zucchini.
Toss with pesto and halved cherry tomatoes. So easy.
Third is a simple zucchini soup. Sauté one onion and two cloves garlic.
Add four cups diced zucchini, four cups vegetable broth.
Simmer 20 minutes then blend until smooth.
